chunks: He said: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Umar al-Zayyat informed us that Ali ibn Ismail reported to him from Muhammad ibn Khalaf, who reported from al-Husayn al-Ashqar, who reported from Qays, from Layth ibn Abi Sulaym, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, reporting from al-Husayn ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

Remain steadfast on our love, the Ahlul Bayt. For he who meets Allah while loving us shall enter Paradise through our intercession. By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, a servant does not benefit from his deeds except by knowing us.

key_terms.أهل البيت: People of the House -- the Prophet's household, a central concept in Shia Islam referring to the Prophet, Fatimah, Ali, Hasan, and Husayn
key_terms.شفاعة: Intercession -- the act of mediating on behalf of someone before Allah on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.معرفة: Knowledge, recognition -- deeper spiritual cognizance of the Ahlul Bayt's divinely appointed status
key_terms.مودة: Love, affection -- specifically the deep attachment and loyalty toward the Prophet's household (Ahlul Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about the love of Ahlul Bayt and entering Paradise?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through Imam al-Husayn (AS), the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) commands the believers to cling firmly to the love of the Ahlul Bayt (the Prophet's household). He promises that those who love the Ahlul Bayt will enter Paradise through their intercession, and emphasizes that no good deed benefits a person without recognizing the status of the Prophet's family.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Umar al-Zayyat informed us that ‘Ali ibn Ismail reported to him from Muhammad ibn Khalaf, who reported from al-Husayn al-Ashqar, who reported from Qais, from Laith ibn Abi Sulaim, from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Laila, reporting from Al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon him, that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "

Remain steadfast on our love, the Ahlul Bayt. For he who meets Allah with our love, will enter the Paradise with our intercession. By He Who controls my soul, a servant (of Allah) does not benefit from his deeds except by knowing us (and our stature)."
